Pick six is an informal term used in American football to refer to an interception (informally called a pick) that’s returned for a touchdown (which is worth six points). In other words, it’s a name for what happens when a defensive player intercepts a pass and is then able to return the ball all the way to the opponent’s end zone, thus scoring a touchdown.
Pick six is informal, but it’s the most common way of referring to an interception returned for a touchdown. It’s considered among the most exciting plays in football.
